subject.title: auth_profile_store (SQLite) not synced when API key is updated in openclaw.json

question: When a provider API key is edited in `openclaw.json`, should gateway startup reconcile a configuration-derived persisted model credential, or should an existing per-agent catalog/API-key override remain authoritative?
rationale: The current documented merge order permits persisted catalog values to override configuration, while changing that rule can alter existing agent-specific setups; source inspection alone cannot safely choose the compatibility contract.

options.title: Reconcile configuration-derived credentials
options.body: Track or identify configuration-derived entries and refresh only those on restart, while retaining explicit per-agent overrides.

options.title: Retain persisted-catalog precedence
options.body: Keep the current override contract and improve diagnostics plus documentation so configuration edits that are shadowed are visible.

options.title: Make configuration globally authoritative
options.body: Always prefer `openclaw.json`, accepting that existing per-agent catalog overrides may stop taking effect.

recommendation.title: Reconcile configuration-derived credentials
recommendation.body: Track or identify configuration-derived entries and refresh only those on restart, while retaining explicit per-agent overrides.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent provider/auth work makes this the strongest available routing candidate, though ownership confidence is limited.
